265	    def adopt(self, s, sheets):
266	        """Its reply changed some of our non-price terms (in its counter or an alternative): it told
267	        us what it values. Take a sheet's terms over when C at its price beats C of our plan at
268	        our counterpart of that price; when it insists on an index clause, take the clause that
269	        costs us least."""
270	        if not s.ours:
271	            return
272	        case = self.case
273	        standing_terms = sheets[0]["terms"]
274	        clause = standing_terms.get("index_clause")
275	        if "index_clause" in s.terms and s.terms["index_clause"] != clause and clause:
276	            # it will not sell this term at a fixed price (raw-material distributors) and refuses a
277	            # deadband: take its clause when its sheet, clause included, costs us less than its
278	            # last one (P08, P18: a longer contract came with it) and keeps every must-have; else
279	            # keep asking for a fixed price (P02: the copper clause alone cost 1.8 % of spend)
280	            new = {**s.terms, "index_clause": clause}
281	            c_now = eco.cost(case, standing_terms, s.std, s.est)
282	            c_before = eco.cost(case, s.last_sheet, s.std, s.est)
283	            if eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std) and c_now < c_before - 1.0:
284	                self.switch(s, new, "its index clause")
285	            else:
286	                self.note(s.sid, "keep_terms", why="its index clause costs us more", c_now=c_now, c_before=c_before)
287	        best_c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, s.terms, self.their_price(s, standing_terms)), s.std, s.est)
288	        for sheet in sheets:
289	            terms = sheet["terms"]
290	            changed = {k: v for k, v in terms.items() if k != "unit_price" and k in s.terms and s.terms[k] != v}
291	            changed.pop("index_clause", None)
292	            if not changed:
293	                continue
294	            new = {**s.terms, **changed}
295	            if not eco.must_haves_ok(case, new, s.std):
296	                continue
297	            if any((k, repr(v)) in s.tried for k, v in changed.items()):
298	                continue  # we were there before: no flip-flop
299	            c = eco.cost(case, eco.at_price(case, new, terms["unit_price"]), s.std, s.est)
300	            if c < best_c - max(1.0, 0.001 * best_c):
301	                best_c = c
302	                s.tried |= {(k, repr(s.terms.get(k))) for k in changed}
303	                self.switch(s, new, f"its sheet {changed} costs us less")

307	        """The next message to this supplier: {"message": ...}, or None when the thread is done.

309	        case, s, events = self.case, self.sides[sid], threads[sid]
310	        self.writer_s = writer_s
311	        s.prev_state = s.state
312	        last = latest(events)
313	        status = last.get("status")
314	        if s.state == "ended" or status in ENDED:
315	            s.state = "ended"
316	            return None
317	        sheets = [sh for sh in last.get("term_sheets") or [] if sh.get("terms", {}).get("unit_price") is not None]
318	        if not sheets:
319	            s.state = "ended" if not standing(events)[0] else "done"
320	            return None
321	        s.std = standard_terms(events) or s.std
322	        fresh = s.last_reply is not last

324	            terms_before = dict(s.terms)

326	            s.term_change = any(sheets[0]["terms"].get(k, v) != v for k, v in terms_before.items() if k != "unit_price")

334	            s.state = "done"
335	            return None
336	        left = self.moves_left(s, events)
337	        if status in DONE or left <= 0:
338	            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, left)
339	        if s.target and theirs <= s.target * 1.002:
340	            # relationship goal: below the target a lower price costs more than it saves
341	            s.state = "closing"
342	            return self.send(s, [eco.at_price(case, s.terms, max(s.target, theirs))], [], events, theirs)

344	            return self.finish(s, sheets, events, theirs, left)

353	    def next_price(self, s, theirs):
354	        """Our next price at s.terms: open at the anchor; then a share of the gap, held low after a
355	        large concession, and within the patience budget."""
356	        if not s.ours:
357	            return s.anchor, FIRST_CLAIMS
358	        last = s.ours[-1]
359	        gap = (theirs - last) / theirs
360	        conceded = (s.theirs[-2] - theirs) / s.theirs[-2] if len(s.theirs) > 1 else 0.0
361	        share = FRACTION
362	        if len(s.ours) == 1 and conceded >= DEEP and not s.term_change:
363	            # a deep floor: a pure price drop this large means it moves fast on its own (job shops,
364	            # P05, D02) and agrees at our sheet next: hold the anchor (Dralveck agreed at a held
365	            # 27.86, at 28.07 after an 8 % step); a drop that came with terms it added (an index
366	            # clause, P08, P18) is not one
367	            share = 0.0
368	        left = max(0.0, s.budget - sum(s.gaps))
369	        new_gap = min(gap * (1 - share), left / 2)
370	        if s.budget < 0.2:  # a touchy supplier: small, steady gaps
371	            new_gap = min(new_gap, 0.015)
372	        price = theirs * (1 - new_gap)
373	        price = max(price, last * (1 + MIN_MOVE))
374	        price = min(price, theirs * 0.998)
375	        return round(max(price, last), 2), LATER_CLAIMS

381	        std = s.std
382	        c_stand = eco.cost(case, sheets[0]["terms"], std, s.est)
383	        alts = [(eco.cost(case, sh["terms"], std, s.est), sh) for sh in sheets[1:]]

395	        """The next unused claims for this supplier: in an RFQ the cheapest rival offer first (a new
396	        offer is a new argument every round), then its own claims, strongest first."""
397	        out = []
398	        rivals = []
399	        for other, events in threads.items():
